scope: Qualitative audit from recorded evaluation videos. No additional environment actions or teacher calls.
caption: On the same Spatial reset23, native leaves the milk carton in place and moves a bowl onto the plate. The V7 checkpoint after two collections instead grasps the milk and moves it to the plate; the simulator reports success after178 controls, versus native failure at300. This is one example of changed object selection, not proof of why learning helped. Original pre-action frames are shown; the last recorded frame precedes the final action. The autonomous checkpoint used11 useful native-action windows and no assisted command in its training windows.
selection: Reset23 is the first gained evaluation success after the scheduled two-collection score was known. Selected for qualitative illustration, not independent confirmation or a representative random example. The complete ten-reset scores and later checkpoints remain reported.
